project_type: Flutter mobile app (Dart) with Riverpod state management and Supabase (PostgREST + Postgres) backend
build_system: Flutter (pub). NOTE: Flutter/Dart is NOT installed in this sandbox, so `flutter analyze`/`flutter build` cannot run. Verification is by careful reading, brace/paren balance checks (grep -c), and matching existing patterns.
test_framework: None relevant to this change; no unit tests exercise these providers.
build_command: flutter build apk (NOT runnable in sandbox - Flutter not installed)
test_command: flutter test (NOT runnable in sandbox - Flutter not installed)
verification_instructions: 1) grep for `.from('jobs')`, `.from('job_applications')`, `.from('banners')` across lib/ MUST return ZERO matches. 2) Every rpc('name', params:{...}) in the two Dart files must match a function name + parameter names defined in supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql. 3) Brace/paren balance in both Dart files: `grep -o '{' file | wc -l` == `grep -o '}' file | wc -l`, same for ( ). 4) No changes to lib/services/supabase_service.dart, notifications inserts, credit_wallet rpc, or users-table access.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Edit Dart files under lib/ and create one SQL file under supabase/. The SQL is applied manually by the user in the Supabase SQL Editor (out of scope for the coder to run).
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no external Supabase/DB access, cannot pull packages, cannot run Flutter toolchain. All verification is static (reading + grep counts). Only edit files under /projects/sandbox/Rexo-Kotlin (ignore the stale /projects/sandbox/Rexo-store- copy). Work only on the existing checked-out branch; do not create branches or PRs.
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing provider names, return types, enrichment shape (rows still carry 'jobs' and 'users' sub-maps), ref.invalidate() calls, try/catch error handling. Do NOT touch supabase_service.dart, notifications provider/inserts, wallet provider, credit_wallet rpc, or the users table.
key_patterns: Supabase client accessed as SupabaseService.client (lib/services/supabase_service.dart). Current user: SupabaseService.currentUser (user.id is a String). RPC call style already used elsewhere: SupabaseService.client.rpc('credit_wallet', params: {'p_user_id': userId, 'p_amount': amount}). Existing SECURITY DEFINER + case-insensitive helper public.is_admin() (users.id::text = auth.uid()::text AND lower(role)='admin'). Existing SECURITY DEFINER function credit_wallet(p_user_id uuid, p_amount numeric). job_applications.user_id is compared with auth.uid()::text in existing policies (both sides cast to text). rpc() returns dynamic; setof-returning functions are cast with List<Map<String,dynamic>>.from(response as List).
relevant_files: lib/core/utils/error_utils.dart (revert the TEMP DEBUG passthrough block)
supabase/jobs_migration.sql (authoritative schema for jobs + job_applications columns)
supabase/wallet_balance_rpc.sql (SECURITY DEFINER + admin-check pattern to mirror)
directory_structure: lib/features/<feature>/providers/*.dart holds Riverpod providers that call Supabase. lib/services/supabase_service.dart wraps the client. lib/core/utils/error_utils.dart sanitizes errors. supabase/ holds SQL migrations run manually in the Supabase SQL Editor; the new RPC file goes there.
